detailed_descriptions.en: Deliria is a world you cut open. It is an infinite multiplayer sandbox where the building has no blocks. Ride mounts, command pets and summons, switch between swords, guns, bows and magic, and push your style rank up while the soundtrack goes enormous behind you. 17 BIOMES. A WORLD TOO BEAUTIFUL TO BE SAFE Over 17 biomes with their own weather, light and wildlife: deep forests, deserts, frozen ridges, ruins. 10 NPCS Build a house and someone moves in. Build a few more and you have a town MULTIPLAYER IS THE HEART OF DELIRIA Deliria is better with people in it. Explore together, build enormous arenas, gang up on bosses, hold the town through an invasion. Or flip PvP on. 9 BOSSES AND EVERYTHING UNDERNEATH THEM Nine bosses, hundreds of ordinary nightmares in between, and a bestiary that fills itself in as you go. 2 INVASIONS. A COMBAT SYSTEM THAT KEEPS SCORE Your attacks build a style rank, letter by letter, the way character action games do it. Keep the chain going and it climbs. Get hit, get sloppy, or lean on one button and it falls. Can you win against legions of spears, and hundreds of arrows? A SANDBOX WITH NO SHAPE LIMITS Smooth terrain, spheres, ramps, overhangs, caves you dig out by hand. Creative mode for when you just want to build, plus a grapple and a set of wings for when the ground stops being interesting. A BOOK THAT REMEMBERS WHAT YOU DID The Necronomicon tracks what you have found, what you have killed and what you have not met yet, chapter by chapter, with missions pointing you at whatever you should be scared of next. 70 achievements too. AND SOMETHING UNDERNEATH ALL OF IT There is another dimension under this one. It is dark, it is sealed, and getting into it is a puzzle of its own. A SOUNDTRACK THAT ADAPTS TO YOUR STYLE Carve the world. Face the horror. Bring your friends. Survive Deliria.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Deliria is a world you cut open.

It is an infinite multiplayer sandbox where the building has no blocks. Ride mounts, command pets and summons, switch between swords, guns, bows and magic, and push your style rank up while the soundtrack goes enormous behind you.

17 BIOMES. A WORLD TOO BEAUTIFUL TO BE SAFE

Over 17 biomes with their own weather, light and wildlife: deep forests, deserts, frozen ridges, ruins.

10 NPCS

Build a house and someone moves in. Build a few more and you have a town

MULTIPLAYER IS THE HEART OF DELIRIA

Deliria is better with people in it. Explore together, build enormous arenas, gang up on bosses, hold the town through an invasion. Or flip PvP on.

9 BOSSES AND EVERYTHING UNDERNEATH THEM

Nine bosses, hundreds of ordinary nightmares in between, and a bestiary that fills itself in as you go. 

2 INVASIONS. A COMBAT SYSTEM THAT KEEPS SCORE

Your attacks build a style rank, letter by letter, the way character action games do it. Keep the chain going and it climbs. Get hit, get sloppy, or lean on one button and it falls. Can you win against legions of spears, and hundreds of arrows?

A SANDBOX WITH NO SHAPE LIMITS

Smooth terrain, spheres, ramps, overhangs, caves you dig out by hand. Creative mode for when you just want to build, plus a grapple and a set of wings for when the ground stops being interesting.

A BOOK THAT REMEMBERS WHAT YOU DID

The Necronomicon tracks what you have found, what you have killed and what you have not met yet, chapter by chapter, with missions pointing you at whatever you should be scared of next. 70 achievements too.

AND SOMETHING UNDERNEATH ALL OF IT

There is another dimension under this one. It is dark, it is sealed, and getting into it is a puzzle of its own.

A SOUNDTRACK THAT ADAPTS TO YOUR STYLE

Carve the world. Face the horror. Bring your friends. Survive Deliria.
